name: The Fenlands
description: The wide country past the Mirewater Tunnel: marsh to the north, heath to the south, and the trading town of Rivenhal in the middle of it.

fn_0_0.name: Tunnel Fen
fn_0_0.description: Flat wet ground and tall reeds under a wide, pale sky. The tunnel country is behind you to the north.

fn_0_1.name: Reedwater
fn_0_1.description: A low, tussocky country of standing water and old cart tracks. The tunnel country is behind you to the north.

fn_0_2.name: The Southern Mouth
fn_0_2.description: The tunnel lets you out onto a wide, wet plain under a low sky. A black arch behind you leads back into the mire. To the south, a town's walls show faintly through the mist.

fn_0_3.name: Sallow Mere
fn_0_3.description: Scattered stones, grass, and the occasional hunched tree. The tunnel country is behind you to the north.

fn_0_4.name: Dun Water
fn_0_4.description: Flat wet ground and tall reeds under a wide, pale sky. The tunnel country is behind you to the north.

fn_1_0.name: Mist Bank
fn_1_0.description: Dry heath and thistle, the wind never still. The tunnel country is behind you to the north.
